scope: Soft AI selection preference against third frontier occurrences; no draw or legality changes

policy.easy: prefer nonrepeating candidates when any exist
policy.medium_hard: 0.25 pawn root-only cost, adjusted alpha bound; score remains raw
policy.neural: log(1.1) policy logit cost, original logits and model preserved
policy.candidate_annotation: reuse existing validated leaf, shared search deadline, no extra replay

limits: Finite Arena samples with wall-clock searches are not proof that all loops or timeouts are impossible.
Only enumerated complete Action candidates can be preferred; forced or sufficiently higher-scoring repetitions remain legal and selectable.
Historical boards differ even when frontiers match; no automatic draw or complete-state transposition is introduced.
A local piece can still shuffle without repeating the complete frontier, for example when relative timeline times keep changing.
Earlier Hard20 is context, not an exact-state causal replay; time-bounded searches may diverge.
Rules, planner budgets and model weights unchanged; changes remain local and uncommitted.
